reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes an automated crypto-trading bot while claiming it can produce 210 dollars per day and instructing viewers to fund a wallet with Arbitrum ETH and stablecoins. It also directs viewers to enter a MetaMask private key for a wallet described as controlling swaps, linking sensitive credential disclosure and asset-funded participation to the promoted activity. The speaker reports only a 0.64-dollar one-day result and notes that performance depends on market volatility, so guaranteed returns, actual losses, and later outcomes are not established.

citations.quote: I input $100 on Arbitrum
The all-time profit was 0.64 dollars which is 0.64% in one day
you copy your 64 letter private key and paste it here then you click Save
top off your wallet with Arbitrum ETH and stable coins, and you can run your own bot within 5 minutes

opening.argument: Judge the return claim against the speaker's own qualifications. He reports a modest one-day result, not a fixed payout: the all-time profit was $0.64, and he expressly says performance depends on volatility. He even identifies a market pump during the run. Those details make this a discussion of a conditional trading result, not evidence that viewers are promised a repeatable daily return.

citations.quote: The all-time profit was 0.64 dollars which is 0.64% in one day
but it depends on market volatility and as you can see it was a huge pump when I ran it

rebuttal.rebuttal: The $100 on Arbitrum is described as the speaker's test amount, while the $0.64 result and volatility qualification limit what that test establishes. The private-key instruction is concerning, but the cited passage identifies it as a wallet-import step for controlling swaps; it does not establish that the speaker receives the key. The invitation to fund a wallet shows how the bot is used, not that the reported return is guaranteed.

citations.quote: I input $100 on Arbitrum
but it depends on market volatility
because that's the one that is going to be controlling the bot with swaps etc

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A volatility qualification does not erase the promotion. The title advertises a daily dollar gain, and the walkthrough tells viewers to paste a MetaMask private key into the bot and fund a wallet to run it. The small reported test result neither substantiates the headline nor resolves the credential risk.

citations.quote: +210$ on Bear Market Per DAY
you copy your 64 letter private key and paste it here then you click Save
top off your wallet with Arbitrum ETH and stable coins, and you can run your own bot within 5 minutes

opening.argument: The substance of the video is an operational walkthrough. The speaker calls it a step-by-step guide, explains where to find the wallet import and bot settings, then discusses trading pairs, order size, and the chain to select. He also shows a stopped bot rather than presenting an uninterrupted stream of earnings. A careful reading should distinguish teaching viewers how a tool is configured from proving that its trades will make money.

citations.quote: I wanted to do a quick step-by-step guide tutorial video about how to create a great trading bot
the first thing you do is you click on wallets you click on import new wallet
I have one stop in bots. The all-time profit was 0.64 dollars which is 0.64% in one day
you select the arbitrum chain not the binance smart chain not the polygon chain

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution accurately identifies a key-import instruction and a funding step, but those are also the concrete operations this tutorial demonstrates. Its cited one-day result is $0.64, not the headline's $210; the walkthrough does not show $210 being earned. The evidence supports scrutiny of the instructions, but does not by itself establish that this demonstration delivered the advertised daily result or that the speaker took viewers' funds.

citations.quote: you copy your 64 letter private key and paste it here then you click Save
The all-time profit was 0.64 dollars which is 0.64% in one day
+210$ on Bear Market Per DAY

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The instructional format is precisely how the promotion reaches viewers. The speaker directs them to export and paste a private key, then to put assets into a wallet to run the bot. A $0.64 example and a stopped bot do not validate the daily-gain headline; they leave its much larger claim unsupported.

citations.quote: you click on account details export private key
you copy your 64 letter private key and paste it here then you click Save
top off your wallet with Arbitrum ETH and stable coins, and you can run your own bot within 5 minutes
+210$ on Bear Market Per DAY

opening.argument: The description presents a downloadable trading tool with ordinary software features: interface languages, automated stop-loss settings, notifications, an error log, and a limited free-use period. It also claims users need not enter a private key into that advertised bot. Those claims do not certify the software as safe, and the spoken walkthrough gives a different key-import instruction. But the supplied material does not show a required payment to the creator, a downline scheme, or the destination's operation. The narrower, supportable reading is product promotion with serious unresolved questions, not proof of a completed theft mechanism.

citations.quote: Download►► https://2no.co/2lX2X2
Take profit and stop loss are set automatically.
Have an error log file to track in the bot folder.
Free use, within 21 days from the moment of installation, there are no conditions for using the bot.
you do not need to enter the private key into the bot, the bot trades together with the Metamask.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The private-key instruction is the strongest concern, especially because it conflicts with the description's security claim. Still, the prosecution's citations show an import form and instructions to fund the viewer's wallet, not a transfer to the creator or evidence of what happens to the key afterward. The $0.64 display is a reported example, not proof of a guaranteed return or of subsequent losses.

citations.quote: you copy your 64 letter private key and paste it here then you click Save
you do not need to enter the private key into the bot
top off your wallet with Arbitrum ETH and stable coins
The all-time profit was 0.64 dollars which is 0.64% in one day

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The absent evidence of a completed theft does not neutralize what viewers are asked to do. The description advertises a download while asserting that no private key is needed; the walkthrough explicitly instructs viewers to export and paste one. Alongside the daily-gain headline and funding instruction, that contradiction is central to assessing the promotion, regardless of whether later losses are visible.
